## KindMismatchDefect.markable property

Whether these counts are valid kind evidence for an `unsupported` marker: no value matched, and no observed kind is one the declared type could expect under any resolution of its type names (`possibleValueKinds`<!-- -->). The probe only reports this; it never writes a marker.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly markable: boolean;
```
